subject: SIG onboarding: presign window, steward claim, and CAIQ mapping clarifications
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@orchidpay.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: onetrust-admin@orchidpay.com
Date: 2028-05-24T16:12:00Z
Subject: Request: delegated steward + presign upload window for SIG profile

Hi Camila —

Thanks for helping us get the SIG/CAIQ material into our Whistic profile. Two quick asks from our side so we can finish the ingestion this week: 

1) Delegated steward: can Redwood claim a steward on our Whistic profile (delegated upload role) so your team can complete the CAIQ mapping and batch-presign uploads? We can grant a short-lived steward role if needed.

2) Presign upload window: our legal team needs a planned presign window for large bundle ingestion (we have ~2.1GB of artifacts). Can you propose a 4-hour window next week (UTC preferred) and confirm S3 presign TTL you'd accept?

If useful, attached is a starter inventory (orchid_inventory_v1.csv) with pointers to the SOC 2 report location and KMS rotation notes. We also need a clear contact for the SOC2 proof-of-possession check and a KMS rotation artifact (either signed statement or key thumbprint).

Lydia Park
Sr. Security Ops, OrchidPay
lydia.park@orchidpay.com

Attachments: orchid_inventory_v1.csv (csv stub listing artifacts and S3 prefixes)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@orchidpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-24T18:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: delegated steward + presign upload window for SIG profile

Hi Lydia —

Appreciate the inventory — this is the right level of detail. Short answers up front: yes, we can be granted a delegated steward for the Whistic/Onetrust profile and yes, we can take a 4-hour presign window to stage the bulk upload.

Proposed next steps / ask list:
- Steward assignment: please grant "delegated uploader" to steward@redwood-internal (we'll rotate a scoped service account once the window is scheduled).
- Presign window proposal: May 29, 2028 02:00–06:00 PT (09:00–13:00 UTC). If that doesn't work, we can shift to May 30 same window.
- Presign TTL: we recommend 6 hours for large bundles; if your S3 policy requires shorter TTLs we can accommodate 2–3 hours but will chunk uploads.
- Manifest: attach a filled manifest template (see attached redwood-presign-checklist.pdf) — please confirm object keys and total expected bytes per prefix.
- Evidence format: SOC2 PDF + signed KMS rotation statement OR KMS thumbprint + rotation log snippet are both fine. Large logs: a signed hash is acceptable if you also provide a keyed-access audit path.

Marissa, Mina, Jonas — looping you in for CAIQ mapping and KMS rotation confirmation; Marissa will drive the CAIQ mapping sheet and Mina will validate the rotation artifact approach.

I'll stand up a short Zoom for presign-day coordination if helpful.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Security Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: redwood-presign-checklist.pdf (manifest template and preflight checklist)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@orchidpay.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-25T13:30:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG onboarding: presign window, steward claim, and CAIQ mapping clarifications

On Thu, May 24, 2028 at 18:00 Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Appreciate the inventory — this is the right level of detail. Short answers up front: yes, we can be granted a delegated steward...

Thanks everyone — quick follow / clarifications from the CAIQ side: 
- We'll map the inventory rows into the CAIQ 3.1 matrix; if you have any already-populated answers please flag them so we don't overwrite.
- I attached a fresh CAIQ mapping workbook (caiaq-mapping-orchid.xlsx) with two tabs: "inventory-match" and "assumptions." Please review before presign.
- For any items that require SOC2 evidence pointing to a control (e.g., CC3.2-key-rotation), include the SOC2 section/page and the S3 prefix in the manifest. That speeds reviewers' sampling.

Lydia — can you confirm a HubSpot contact (or HubSpot id) and whether you need a DocuSign for the delegated steward change? I noted a DocuSign request on your intake form.

I'll be on the call for the presign window and will own the CAIQ ingest once we have the manifest.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Technical Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: caiaq-mapping-orchid.xlsx (CAIQ mapping workbook)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@orchidpay.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-26T15:15:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG onboarding: presign window, steward claim, and CAIQ mapping clarifications

Hi all —

Couple of technical confirmations from the KMS / evidence side: 
- KMS rotation artifact: OrchidPay can provide either (A) a signed rotation statement with key thumbprint + rotation timestamp, or (B) a trimmed rotation log (last-2 rotations) with signatures. Both are acceptable. If you choose (B) please redact any unrelated principal ids.
- For very large syslog/audit exports we accept a SHA256 manifest + signed attestation and a path to archived logs (S3 prefix). We'll anchor that with a short-lived presign link so the reviewer can sample the logs.
- TTL note: for our ingest tooling a 6-hour presign TTL is ideal (we can coordinate multipart uploads in that window). If you must use 2–3 hours we'll shard the bundle into smaller chunks — please let us know preferred TTL.

I'm attaching a short KMS rotation statement template we typically ask vendors to sign (kms-rotation-statement.txt). If OrchidPay wants, we can host a quick check where we validate the thumbprint against a supplied JWK.

Looking forward to the presign window.

Mina Haddad
Applied Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: kms-rotation-statement.txt (statement template and guidance)
